data.translation: Uncle Isho: The first mill, Yusef Serti; first, I reckon, the first factory that came to Midyat, Yusef Serti brought it. And afterwards they brought one for Yaqube of the Aho Bahhe family too; they brought one, he was in partnership with them. Yes, and afterwards they brought them, all over.

rationale: Thin new Preterit-wa/1 cell; singular agent and aʕmayye partner complement the plural project example.

data.turoyo: Xori Brahim: Təǧǧar rabe, ṣənʕatkar, bu aṣəl qonyaliye ne. Eee, kətwo təǧǧar rabe. Kətwo armənoye ste mšarkiwo aʕmayye. Kmo bote armənoye wən. Hənne ste aʕmayye wən. Yaʕni farq latwo. Am mšiḥoye kulle hanək wən.
data.translation: Father Brahim: Big merchants, craftsmen; originally they are people of Konya. Yes, there were big merchants. There were Armenians too, who shared with them. There were a few Armenian households. They too were with them. That is, there was no difference. All the Christians were those people.

rationale: First Infectum-wa box, active II partnership with overt aʕmayye, not evidence of a Detransitive.

data.turoyo: ʕAl haṯe, ya ǧamaʕa! Aḥna kəbʕena ʕəmum d həwele, walaw mšarakle ste adyawma bi munasabe di ḥaflaṯe, kəbʕina ʕəmum d mišarki, ḥatta kulan d həwelan əšmo, d həwena kefe mʔasse bi ʕitaṯe.
data.translation: Therefore, congregation! We want everyone to have a part, even if he has also participated today on the occasion of this celebration. We want everyone to participate, so that we may all have a name, so that we may be stones established in this church.

rationale: Thin new Preterit/1 cell; participation in a church celebration extends the setting already widened in round 1.

data.turoyo: Umarno: "Ṭrowe, abuna, ʕal aʕ ʕayne." W mədili mene, gəršili qopya w madʕərili naqla ḥreto luwwe. U mede, d mədli mene, kule mšarakli bu kṯowano. Kul lišono ste l ruḥe səmli.
data.translation: I said: 'Leave it to me, our father, on my eyes.' And I took them from him, made a copy, and returned them to him once again. Everything that I took from him I included in this book. I put each language separately too.

rationale: Sole example for new material-incorporation sense; retain copy/return and book context to disambiguate the inanimate object.

data.turoyo: W bəṯr ann əšmone daq qəryawoṯe du Ṭuro lu tərki. Bani klulle, Xori ʕAziz m kul lebe mšarakle bənne. Annaqqa harke kəmšayalno, ʕaǧaba, Xori ʕAziz d luwewo, gədhuwewo u ġəyorano əlla lo? Əno u ǧawabayḏe gudhuwewo w 'e' yo. Harke Xori ʕAziz kbode bu ʕwodayḏe (kowe ale) u rasmi lašan i dawle d Kamal.
data.translation: And after that, the names of the villages of Tur Abdin into Turkish. In all of these, Priest Aziz participated with all his heart. Now here I ask: I wonder, if Priest Aziz had not been there, would this change have happened or not? My answer here would be “yes”. Here, with his actions, Priest Aziz begins (perhaps) the official work for Kemal’s state.

rationale: Thin Preterit/1 cell; bənne explicitly marks the activities participated in, contrasting with ʕam associates.

summary: Sense 1: revise the gloss
after: beteiligen; (mit ʕam) sich beteiligen, sich zusammentun
rationale: The inherited Imperativ admits another participant, but inherited 63/39 joins existing associates and JTM 1.1/67 describes families working together without an object. Clarifies both directions of the partnership meaning, rather than treating all uses as transitive beteiligen.

summary: II has an active transitive admission request with -li and objectless participation, optionally with ʕam associates. Objectless cooperation is not Detransitive.
Agricultural collective work broadens the setting of the inherited trade partnership without changing the lexical meaning. The Arabic borrowing is lexical, not a light-verb idiom.
Preterit and Preterit-wa l-series forms contrast with active mšarkiwo Infectum-wa. Base forms listed in the glossary do not replace textual box examples.
The absence of a transitive object does not make partnership Detransitive. This is already an active intransitive use after round 1.
The technical incorporation use belongs to the prose discussion of compiling a book; it should not retroactively change the partnership examples.
Verify whether ʕam is required for an explicitly named associate or optional when partners are recoverable, as in JTM 1.1/67.
At Jan 1.36/1521, is mšarki an active plural predicate about owners, a shared-ownership adjective about shops, or a result form? No Detransitive is accepted pending this distinction.
Confirm whether mišarki (Jan 2.12/2845) is ordinary epenthesis in the active form or a distinct morphological form.
Collective grass-gathering rather than commerce; same partnership meaning and participant grouping.

Ordinary participation covers commerce, shared lime-making, church celebrations and official renaming. ʕam marks an associate; b- marks a sphere/project. These corroborate the round-1 widening beyond transitive beteiligen.
